summary: Custer County, ID rooftop lookout: a fire finder on a barn roof from 1935, abandoned in 1951; no source describes the site today.

facts.design: fire finder set on a barn roof (rooftop, not a tower)
facts.status_note: Abandoned in 1951 per three sources and the Forest Fire Lookout Association list; no source says what, if anything, remains on the site
facts.agency: Sawtooth National Forest per Forest Lookouts; Challis National Forest per FireLookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts

events.note: Earliest date the listings give, when a fire finder sat on a barn roof. No listing gives a build date, so this is the first recorded date, not construction; the listings describe a rooftop site, not a tower
Three listings give 1951 as the year it was abandoned

evidence.supports: location: Custer County, about five miles southeast of Obsidian
1935 fire finder on a barn roof
evidence.quote: 1935: A firefinder on a barn roof.

evidence.supports: classed as a rooftop lookout and marked abandoned
publisher does not yet have a record of who staffed the lookout
evidence.quote: We don't yet have a documented staffing history for this lookout

corrections.why: The Forest Fire Lookout Association list marks Sawtooth Valley as Abandoned, not Gone, and none of the four sources says a structure was removed.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Forest Lookouts names the Sawtooth National Forest; FireLookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts name the Challis National Forest. The story reports both and does not pick one, because no source settles it.

sources.title: Idaho Lookouts - Forest Fire Lookout Association

notes_for_editor: The 1935 and 1951 dates appear on three listings that look like one shared inventory (Forest Lookouts marks its entries '(Kresek)'), so they are not three independent confirmations. The brief's status 'gone' conflicts with the FFLA 'Abandoned' status (see corrections). Elevation 6,904 ft from Idaho Fire Lookouts has no facts key, so it appears only in the story. The forest question is open and could be settled by Sawtooth or Challis National Forest records. No photo, NHLR or FFLOS number was found; the FFLA row has no registry entry. Brief coordinates 44.02978, -114.82511 match the FFLA list.
